title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I hear you guys are going to all-digital tickets next season
Not 100%. Avoiding it for suites and clubs.  Big push by Chris Granger. Nobody else wants it. Very tough to handle in baseball because of game volume, senior groups, kids groups etc.
But like 95% (or whatever the number is)
Or it’s not 100% that it’s happening at all

Yea similar to wings. Wings didn’t do suites either. I cant really speak to the certainty but I’ve been told it’s 100% for season tickets (outside of suites and champions club). I’m really only directly involved on the suite and club side so all I know for sure is that my people are getting ticket stock if they want it.
I always check with you on ticket stuff
If you get quotes on it ask for Granger. His choice completely. Nobody else wants to pick this fight right now.
I heard something else but I’m gonna have to call you for that. You got a few?
Or text me later if you’re at the park
Now is better than later- standing up in a wedding today
